annotations.title: List the AI agents that visited a feed site

description: For a Live Visit Feed site: the AI agents that visited, newest first, each with the pages it saw and the story of its visit. A visit is listed when its visitor was an AI agent (an agentic browser or an AI fetcher: `visitor.kind` `ai_agent`, as in a feed event) and the visit stored a feed event. Each row: `visit_id`, `started_at`, `as_of` and `ended` (when the stored event was built, and whether it is the visit's last), `visitor.ai_agent` with `vendor` and `verification`, `pages`, `converted`, `reached_checkout` when it was recorded, and `narrative`. `verification` says how the agent's identity was proven. `web_bot_auth`: it signed its requests, and the signature was checked against the key published at its own origin. `cloudflare_verified_bot`: Cloudflare verified it as an AI bot, which proves the kind of bot and not who runs it. `null`: nothing was proven, and the visit is called an agent's on its user-agent's word alone. `vendor` is the operator, or `other` when it could not be attributed. Never listed: a crawler, a browser driven by a script, a visit judged a bot when it ended, a visit marked as the site's own. Not listed either: an agent's visit that stored no feed event, because it opened no feed (a page load with no gesture and no conversion) or the feed was off; and an agent that names itself nowhere is recorded as a person. So the list is a floor on agent traffic, not its total. `pages` is the stored page list: without query or trailing slash, a numeric id written `:id`, an email or a token replaced. `converted` is an observed goal or a confirmed purchase. The window is the last 7 days unless you pass `since` and `until`, at most 30 days back, read on the visit's start. `limit` is 1 to 50, default 20; pass `next` back as `cursor` for older visits. Pass a `visit_id` to get_visit for the visit's whole last event. It needs an API key from the developer console and the feed turned on for the site; a conversion site's credential is refused with not_feed_site. 60 calls an hour per key, shared with get_visit and get_page_attention; every call is on the developer's record before it runs.

cursor.description: The `next` of the previous page. It carries its own window.

since.description: ISO date. Default: 7 days before `until`. At most 30 days back.

name: list_agent_visits

next.description: Pass as `cursor` for older visits. Null when there are none.

scanned.description: Agent visits examined. One that stored no feed event is examined and not listed, so a page may hold fewer than `limit` and still have a `next`.

visits.description: Newest first. Each: visit_id (pass to get_visit), started_at, as_of, ended, visitor `{ kind: "ai_agent", ai_agent: { vendor, verification } }` (verification: web_bot_auth · cloudflare_verified_bot · null), pages (null when the row kept no list), pages_truncated (only when pages were left out), converted, reached_checkout (only when recorded), narrative.

window.description: `{ since, until }` as applied, on the visit's start.
